note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.3 as updated by RFC 7606 Section 3.d (missing well-known mandatory attributes MUST use treat-as-withdraw) and RFC 4760 (MP-only routes do not require legacy NEXT_HOP). TestSessionRFC4271RevisedAttributeErrors drives an established eBGP Session over net.Pipe with good/bad/good sequences for missing ORIGIN, missing AS_PATH, and missing NEXT_HOP, asserting exact withdrawal payload makeUpdateBody(prefix, nil, nil) on bad and accepted NLRI on good while staying Established. TestRFC4271MandatoryAttributesAcrossUpdateForms proves mixed legacy+MP missing legacy NEXT_HOP yields TreatAsWithdraw while mixed complete and MP-only yield ActionNone.
